name: BNI MyPertamina
notes: One BNI Reward Point per Rp 10.000, doubled on MyPertamina transactions.

The doubled rule wants both a Pertamina merchant name and a fuel code (MCC 5541 or 5542), because the two together are what a fill-up looks like. A MyPertamina payment that reaches the statement under some other code will estimate at the base rate.

The card’s headline is 8% back on fuel bought through the MyPertamina app on at least Rp 250.000. The matching is already here — the doubled rule above finds exactly those purchases, and a Rp 250.000 floor is a field that exists — so what stops it is only the unit: BNI Reward Points and rupiah are different currencies and a card carries one reward program. Whatever ceiling the bank puts on that cashback was not retrieved either.
The annual fee is not recorded — no published figure was found, and bni.co.id is unreachable from here. Enter it on the card terms yourself.
The card launched on 21 December 2024, replacing the earlier BNI-Pertamina card, which is where the terms start.
Transfer partners are not recorded, as on the other BNI cards here.
